event.description:
Did some one say Grand Archive regionals? BECAUSE we sure did! Come join us for our first ever Grand Archive Region event EVER! (We might be a tiny bit excited)
Sign up: 11:00am
Event Start: 11.30am
Entry: $50
Prizing: Everyone who joins receives a Regional Binder, an Event Pack, a Sapphire Pack, and at least one booster pack!!!
The Top 8 Players will receive an invite to Nationals Qualifiers, finalists playmate, and extra Packs based on placement – first place receives a Regional Champion Playmat!
Format: Standard,
Rounds based on attendance, No Top Cut.
event.name: Grand Archive TCG - Constructed - Reginals  Qualifier Event
